name: Moringa leaves
description: The leaves of the drumstick tree — cooked as saag, or dried into powder.

tcm.note: Read with the drumstick pod; pungent and warming.

ayurveda.note: Shigru patra is ushna, tikshna and kapha-reducing, like the pod.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; used against swelling and cold conditions.
